top_temples.name: Ajmer Jain Temple (Soniji Ki Nasiyan)
top_temples.location_note: Ajmer city; a golden temple known for its gilded wooden interior depicting Jain cosmology.

top_temples.name: Nareli Jain Temple
top_temples.location_note: About 7 km from central Ajmer; the newest and most popular Jain temple complex in Rajasthan.

top_temples.name: Shri Rangnath Swami Temple
top_temples.location_note: Ajmer city; South Indian-style architecture.

top_temples.name: Savitri Temple, Ajmer
top_temples.location_note: On a hilltop in Ajmer; best visited at sunrise for views over the city's lakes.

top_temples.name: Gayatri Shaktipeeth (Chamunda Mata Temple)
top_temples.location_note: Ajmer; built in the 19th century, its main chamber known as 'Swarna Nagari' for its gold detailing.

top_temples.name: Kiradu Temples
top_temples.location_note: Kiradu, Barmer district; a complex of five 11th-century temples known for intricately carved stone sculptures.

top_temples.name: Nakoda Jain Temple (Parshwanath Temple)
top_temples.location_note: Barmer district; a major Jain pilgrimage site.

top_temples.name: Jagdambe Temple, Barmer
top_temples.location_note: Barmer city; draws devotees from across the country.

top_temples.name: Vishnu Temple, Khed
top_temples.location_note: Khed, Barmer district; a partially ruined but architecturally significant ancient temple.

top_temples.name: Devka Sun Temple
top_temples.location_note: Devka village, about 62 km from Barmer on the Barmer-Jaisalmer road; built in the 12th-13th century.

top_temples.name: Bhandasar Jain Temple
top_temples.location_note: Bikaner city; a three-storied 15th-16th century shrine noted for gold-leaf walls and mirror work.

top_temples.name: Shri Laxminath Temple
top_temples.location_note: Bikaner; especially crowded during Janmashtami.

top_temples.name: Kodamdesar Temple
top_temples.location_note: About 24 km from Bikaner; installed by Rao Bikaji, originally considered as the founding site of Bikaner before the city was relocated.

top_temples.name: Shiv Bari Temple (Laleshwar Mahadev Mandir)
top_temples.location_note: About 6 km from Bikaner; built by Maharaja Doongar Singh in the 19th century, known for a four-faced black marble Shiva statue.

top_temples.name: Ratan Bihari Temple
top_temples.location_note: Bikaner city.

top_temples.name: Birla Mandir (Lakshmi Narayan Temple)
top_temples.location_note: Tilak Nagar, near Moti Dungari Hill, Jaipur; built entirely of white marble.

top_temples.name: Govind Dev Ji Temple
top_temples.location_note: Within the City Palace complex, Jaipur; one of the city's most revered Krishna shrines.

top_temples.name: Garh Ganesh Temple
top_temples.location_note: Atop the Aravalli Hills near Nahargarh and Jaigarh Forts, Jaipur; dates to the 18th century.

top_temples.name: Moti Dungri Ganesh Mandir
top_temples.location_note: Next to Birla Mandir, Jaipur; the idol is believed to be over 500 years old.

top_temples.name: Tarkeshwar Nath Temple
top_temples.location_note: Choura Rasta area, Jaipur; on a green hill within the city.

top_temples.name: Chamunda Mata Temple
top_temples.location_note: Southern end of Mehrangarh Fort, Jodhpur; the favoured deity of Rao Jodha, idol brought from Mandore in 1460.

top_temples.name: Maha Mandir
top_temples.location_note: About 2 km from central Jodhpur on Mandore Road; 84 pillars carved with yoga postures and floral motifs.

top_temples.name: Raj Ranchhodji Temple
top_temples.location_note: Jodhpur; built in 1905 by Maharani Jadechi Rajkanwar.

top_temples.name: Ganesh Temple, Ratnada Hill
top_temples.location_note: Ratnada Hill, Jodhpur; one of the city's oldest temples.

top_temples.name: Rasik Bihari Temple
top_temples.location_note: Off Udai Mandir Street, Jodhpur; features a Sabha Mandap with red sandstone columns.

top_temples.name: Khade Ganesh Ji Temple
top_temples.location_note: Kota city; especially crowded during Ganesh Chaturthi.

top_temples.name: Mathuradheesh Temple
top_temples.location_note: Kota city.

top_temples.name: Kansua Temple
top_temples.location_note: Kota; ancient shrine believed built by the Pandavas.

top_temples.name: Garadia Mahadev Temple
top_temples.location_note: Hilltop above the Chambal River, Kota.

top_temples.name: Shivpuri Dham, Kota
top_temples.location_note: Kota; a modern temple complex.

top_temples.name: Jain Glass Temple, Nagaur
top_temples.location_note: Nagaur; noted for intricate glasswork and colourful interiors.

top_temples.name: Nagnechi Ji Temple
top_temples.location_note: Nagaur.

top_temples.name: Kaler Mata Temple
top_temples.location_note: Nagaur.

top_temples.name: Bansiwala Temple
top_temples.location_note: Kathariyon ka Chowk, central Nagaur.

top_temples.name: Dadhimati Mata Temple
top_temples.location_note: Nagaur district; one of the oldest surviving temples in northern India, built in the 4th century.

top_temples.name: Parshuram Mahadev Temple
top_temples.location_note: Over 3,990 ft, Pali district; a cave shrine said to have been carved by Parashurama, distinct from the separate Ranakpur temple town entry.

top_temples.name: Nimbo Ka Nath Mahadev Temple
top_temples.location_note: On the Falna-Sanderav route, Pali district; associated with Kunti's worship during the Pandavas' exile.

top_temples.name: Somnath Temple, Pali
top_temples.location_note: Central Pali city; built by King Kumarpal Solanki in Vikram Samvat 1209.

top_temples.name: Adishwar Temple, Pali
top_temples.location_note: Pali city.

top_temples.name: Surya Narayan Temple, Pali
top_temples.location_note: Pali city.

top_temples.name: Bisaldeo Temple
top_temples.location_note: Beside the Bisalpur Dam on the Banas River, Tonk district; the district's best-documented ancient temple.

top_temples.name: Kalyanji Temple, Tonk
top_temples.location_note: Main city of Tonk.

top_temples.name: Govinddeoji Temple, Bavadi
top_temples.location_note: Bavadi village, near Toda Rai Singh town, Tonk district.

top_temples.name: Jaldevi Mandir
top_temples.location_note: Bhagat Singh Colony, Newai town, Tonk district.

top_temples.name: Mahadevali Shiv Mandir
top_temples.location_note: Tonk city.

top_temples.name: Jagdish Temple
top_temples.location_note: Within the City Palace complex, Udaipur; the city's largest and most famous temple, built in Indo-Aryan style.

top_temples.name: Neemach Mata Temple
top_temples.deity: Nimcha Mata (clan deity of the Maharanas)
top_temples.location_note: Atop Devlali Hill overlooking Fateh Sagar Lake, Udaipur.

top_temples.name: Mahakaleshwar Temple, Udaipur
top_temples.location_note: Near Fateh Sagar Lake, opposite Panna Vilas, Udaipur; believed over 900 years old.

top_temples.name: Karni Mata Temple, Udaipur
top_temples.location_note: Machla Magra Hills, Udaipur; a distinct shrine from the more famous Karni Mata 'rat temple' at Deshnoke.

top_temples.name: Bohra Ganesh Temple
top_temples.location_note: Udaipur city.

top_temples.name: Karni Mata Temple
top_temples.location_note: Deshnoke, about 30 km from Bikaner; the famous 'Rat Temple' housing thousands of revered rats believed to be reincarnated devotees. No second distinct temple could be verified within Deshnoke itself despite repeated searches (the historic first Karni Mata shrine is in the separate village of Mathania); this entry lists only one temple.

top_temples.name: Eklingji Temple
top_temples.location_note: Eklingji's central shrine, about 22 km from Udaipur; dates to the 8th century, the guardian deity and family temple of the Mewar royal dynasty, surrounded by a complex of 108 smaller temples.

top_temples.name: Ambika Mata Temple, Eklingji
top_temples.location_note: Within the same Eklingji temple complex, alongside other subsidiary shrines to Ganesha and Kartikeya.

top_temples.name: Galtaji Temple Complex
top_temples.location_note: About 10 km east of Jaipur in the Aravalli Hills; a series of temples built into a hill crevice around seven sacred water tanks, a retreat since the 15th century for ascetics of the Ramananda Sampradaya, also known as the Monkey Temple.

top_temples.name: Surya Mandir, Galtaji
top_temples.location_note: Atop the hill within the same Galtaji complex; a pink sandstone, conical-roofed temple offering panoramic views of Jaipur.

top_temples.name: Khatu Shyam Temple
top_temples.location_note: Khatu Shyamji's central and defining shrine, Sikar district; one of the most heavily visited pilgrimage sites in Rajasthan.

top_temples.name: Gaurishankar Temple, Khatu
top_temples.location_note: In close proximity to the main Khatu Shyam Temple within the same temple town.

top_temples.name: Dilwara Jain Temples
top_temples.deity: Jain Tirthankaras (Rishabh, Neminath, Parshvanath, and others)
top_temples.location_note: Mount Abu; a complex of five white-marble Jain temples built between the 11th and 13th centuries, among India's finest examples of Jain temple architecture.

top_temples.name: Adhar Devi Mandir (Arbuda Mata Mandir)
top_temples.location_note: In a cave on a hillside in Mount Abu, distinct from the Dilwara complex; representing the town's Hindu pilgrimage tradition alongside its famous Jain temples.

top_temples.name: Shrinathji Temple
top_temples.location_note: Nathdwara's central and defining shrine; one of the most important Vaishnava pilgrimage sites in India, of the Pushtimarg (Vallabh) sect.

top_temples.name: Madan Mohanji and Navneet Priyaji Temples
top_temples.deity: Krishna (as Madan Mohan and Navneet Priya)
top_temples.location_note: Subsidiary temples within the same Shrinathji Temple complex in Nathdwara.

top_temples.name: Brahma Temple, Pushkar
top_temples.location_note: Pushkar's defining shrine; one of the very few temples in the world dedicated to Brahma, also known for the associated Pushkar Camel Fair.

top_temples.name: Rangji Temple, Pushkar
top_temples.location_note: About 500 m from the Pushkar bus stand, near Pushkar Lake; built in South Indian Dravidian style, distinct from the Brahma Temple.

top_temples.name: Ranakpur Jain Temple (Chaumukha / Adinatha Temple)
top_temples.location_note: Ranakpur's central shrine; a 15th-century white marble temple with over 1,444 uniquely carved pillars, among India's most important Jain pilgrimage sites.

top_temples.name: Neminath Temple, Ranakpur
top_temples.location_note: A short distance from the main temple within the same Ranakpur complex; smaller and simpler, built in Nagara style.

top_temples.name: Salasar Balaji Temple
top_temples.deity: Hanuman (as Balaji, with beard and moustache)
top_temples.location_note: Salasar's central and defining shrine, Churu district; one of India's most visited Hanuman temples.

top_temples.name: Shri Ram Darbar, Salasar
top_temples.location_note: In the upper part of the same Salasar Balaji Temple structure, above the main Hanuman shrine in the lower part.
